product.description: Latitude Low Rate Mastercard with a low purchase rate of 13.99% p.a., up to 55 days interest free on general purchases, and access to Latitude Rewards discounts and offers.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Applicants must be at least 18 years old.

Applicants must be able to supply: 
- A copy of your driver's licence, passport or proof of age card. 
- Details of your income, assets and debts. 
- Employers name and contact details.
A resident of Australia or a temporary resident who legally has the right to work in Australia (and intend to stay) for at least the next 12 months.
To be eligible you must: Have an income of at least $20,000 gross per year, from employment or investments

Credit history
To be eligible you must: Be able to demonstrate a good credit history for the last 5 years
Product is only eligible for a natural person.

features.additionalInfo:

0% for 25 months Balance Transfer
Pay off your debt faster with 0% p.a. for 25 months on a Balance Transfer. 3% Balance Transfer fee and eligibility criteria apply. New customers only, must be approved by 31 January 2027. Balance Transfer must be submitted by 31 March 2027.

Minimum Monthly Payment

The minimum monthly payment for a statement period is an amount equal to the greater of $30 or 2.75% of the closing balance, shown for the statement period on your statement of account. If your outstanding balance is less than $30, you must pay that balance.
